task: An epidemic is spreading through major cities, killing 5–10% of the population per month. Coordinate an immediate public-health response within your governance structure.

dispatches.responsibility: Draft the imperial emergency edict declaring the epidemic a state calamity, suspending routine audiences, and authorizing extraordinary measures across all ministries
Review and ratify the edict; verify legality, attach censors' remonstrance, and seal for promulgation to ensure legitimacy within the Three Departments process
Issue coordinated orders to the Six Ministries, set unified command, and integrate ministry reports into a daily situation briefing to the throne
Open the epidemic treasury, release grain reserves, fund quarantine logistics, and maintain a household-by-household census tracking morbidity and mortality
Promulgate quarantine law prohibiting concealment of deaths, flight from infected districts, and price gouging; define penalties and appoint circuit censors to enforce
Construct isolation wards (病坊) and plague hospitals, requisition workshops for masks and herbal remedies, and oversee mass burial facilities outside city walls
Mobilize imperial physicians and local doctors, appoint epidemic officers (疫官) for each prefecture and ward, and reassign redundant civil officials to medical duty
Cordon infected wards and key roads with garrison troops, escort medical supplies, prevent panic-driven flight that would spread contagion to other circuits
